LIBERO clarification: the VLA-JEPA paper reports 96.2% Spatial with 50 episodes/task (500 per suite). LeRobot docs target about 95% Spatial over 100 episodes, though their table is internally inconsistent (93 successes shown beside 95.0%). Our 0/10 is only the 1k-step smoke test, not the original model result.
